name: Claude Code login search
description: The hub's keyless search through the Claude Code login: one headless Claude call allowed only the CLI's own web search tool. Chosen by name (QAR_WEB_SEARCH_BACKEND=claude_login) or by the hub loop when the lane has no search backend.
advantages: No search key: it uses the login the lane already holds.
disadvantages: One agent process per search, slower than a search API; links are the model's transcription of the tool's results; subject to the login's usage limits; every search is a model call.
